_README: Per-product corrections applied on top of the inventory sheet.
The sheet is the source of truth for everything. This file exists for the
cases where a row is demonstrably wrong about its own product and the
photograph settles it — the store's decision is that the photo wins.
Keys are product codes. Supported fields:
category    replaces the sheet's Website Category
description replaces the sheet's Description; "" clears it, and the
product then takes the usual '<Category> <CODE>' fallback name
note        why, for whoever reads this next. Never rendered.
Correct the sheet and delete the entry — this is a patch, not a second
catalogue, and every line here is a line that will drift.

THSN085.note: Sheet says 'Pure silver choker' but the photo is a pair of kundan earrings. Reported by the client Sep 2026; store confirmed the photo is correct, so the row's description describes a different piece and is dropped.

THSN102.note: Sheet says 'Nagas Necklace' but the photo is a pair of turquoise drop earrings. Same call as THSN085 — photo wins, description dropped.
